decks.notes: This deck revolves around using Underworld Breach to combo off with Grinding Station and other artifacts to mill opponents quickly and efficiently. Emry, Lurker of the Loch and Urza's Saga help to set up the combo pieces while Malevolent Rumble provides removal and disruption. The deck also includes various mana sources and card draw spells to help find the combo pieces quickly. Overall, the deck is focused on assembling the combo as soon as possible to win the game in a fast and explosive manner.

This deck focuses on playing aggressively with a mix of creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It includes powerful creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Overlord of the Balemurk, along with burn spells like Fatal Push and Chained to the Rocks to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Goblin Bombardment and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah allows for additional damage and removal options. The deck also has a strong mana base with a combination of fetch lands and dual lands to ensure consistent casting of spells.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy is to apply early pressure with creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Guide of Souls, while using burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to remove blockers and close out the game. The deck also utilizes cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Ajani, Nacatl Pariah to generate card advantage and maintain momentum. Overall, the deck aims to win quickly and decisively through a combination of efficient creatures and direct damage.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the Broodscale Bloodchief combo, using cards like Basking Broodscale, Blade of the Bloodchief, and Glaring Fleshraker to generate powerful synergies and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes cards like Boseiju, Who Endures and Kozilek's Command to protect and further enhance the combo. With efficient ramp cards like Mox Opal and Eldrazi Temple, along with powerful search effects like Ancient Stirrings and Urza's Saga, the deck aims to set up its combo pieces quickly and efficiently to secure victory.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury. It also utilizes burn spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment to control the board and finish off the opponent. Cards like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Showdown of the Skalds provide additional support and card advantage. The inclusion of utility lands like Arena of Glory and Chained to the Rocks helps to further solidify the aggressive strategy while cards like Static Prison and Thraben Charm provide disruption against opposing strategies.

The deck aims to take advantage of low-cost creatures with powerful abilities in order to apply pressure on the opponent quickly. By utilizing cards like Aether Vial and Ephemerate to quickly put creatures onto the battlefield, while also having removal spells like Fatal Push to deal with threats, the deck can disrupt the opponent's game plan while establishing its own board presence. The combination of aggressive creatures and disruptive elements creates a strategy that can overwhelm opponents before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck revolves around disrupting and controlling the opponent's plays through a combination of counterspells, removal spells, and card draw. Murktide Regent acts as a mid to late game threat, while Abhorrent Oculus provides continuous card advantage. Unearth allows for recycling key creatures while Thought Scour helps fill the graveyard for Murktide Regent. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents by controlling the board and dictating the pace of the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures with various abilities to create a synergistic toolbox for different situations. It includes cards like Green Sun's Zenith and Chord of Calling to search for specific creatures when needed. The deck also includes Grist, the Hunger Tide and Yawgmoth, Thran Physician to generate value through sacrificing creatures. The goal is to assemble a combination of creatures that work well together to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents in a Modern 1 vs 1 format.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game through card advantage, disruption, and removal spells, while eventually winning with evasive threats like Murktide Regent. The deck aims to interact with the opponent by countering their spells, removing their creatures, and disrupting their hand while also drawing cards and filtering through the deck. The inclusion of graveyard hate like Nihil Spellbomb also helps to manage opposing strategies that rely on the graveyard. Overall, the deck seeks to outvalue the opponent and secure a victory through careful decision-making and resource management.

The deck revolves around utilizing Underworld Breach and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to repeatedly cast spells from the graveyard, generating infinite mana and card advantage. By combining artifacts like Mox Opal and Mishra's Bauble with powerful enchantments like Urza's Saga and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student, the deck can quickly assemble a lethal Combo using cards like Grinding Station and Grapeshot. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a flurry of spells and abilities, ultimately leading to a game-winning combo finish.

This deck aims to control the game through ramping up mana with cards like Utopia Sprawl and the Talismans, while using powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and World Breaker to dominate the battlefield. Karn, the Great Creator provides additional utility and disruption, while Kozilek's Return and Malevolent Rumble offer board control options. Sowing Mycospawn helps to further ramp up mana production, allowing for the deployment of massive threats. Overall, the deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with big threats and efficient removal options.

The deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using various ramp spells and lands to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures. It also includes control elements such as board wipes and counterspells to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The end goal is to overwhelm the opponent with massive Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul, the Promised End and World Breaker, while controlling the board and managing threats using cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Kozilek's Return. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outpace the opponent through ramp and control elements.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay by utilizing a mix of efficient removal spells, disruptive discard spells, and powerful creatures that quickly put pressure on the opponent. The deck aims to control the board early on with hand disruption and removal, then closes out the game with a combination of fast-acting threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Nethergoyf, along with recurring threats like Detective's Phoenix. The deck's mana base allows for consistent casting of spells while also providing flexibility in terms of color requirements.

The Boros Aggro deck aims to win quickly by overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and burn spells. The key strategy revolves around playing efficient threats like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury early in the game, supported by removal spells like Galvanic Discharge and Goblin Bombardment. Additionally, the deck uses powerful cards like Seasoned Pyromancer and Guide of Souls to generate card advantage and maintain pressure on the opponent. This deck seeks to close out the game quickly before the opponent can stabilize, utilizing its efficient creatures and burn spells to secure victory.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's resources while applying pressure with efficient creatures. Utilizing cards like Ephemerate and Aether Vial to manipulate the battlefield, along with removal spells like Fatal Push, the deck aims to control the game and chip away at your opponent's life total. By combining aggressive creatures like Phelia, Exuberant Shepherd and Overlord of the Balemurk with disruptive creatures like Tidehollow Sculler and Skyclave Apparition, the deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent while disrupting their game plan. With a mix of aggression and disruption, this deck aims to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent for a swift victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive creatures that can be constantly blinked in and out of play using cards like Ephemerate and Flickerwisp to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Aether Vial helps cheat creatures into play, while cards like Solitude offer removal options. The deck also includes creatures with powerful enter-the-battlefield abilities to generate value with each blink. Thoughtseize provides hand disruption, while Fatal Push takes out opposing threats. The mana base is designed for consistency and includes both fetch lands and dual lands to ensure the deck can cast its spells effectively.
